category_title: Underachieving students in difficult PE contexts who alternate between task involvement and ephemeral off-task behaviors
scenario_title: Managing peer provocation and safety risks during group work
minimal_context: Students are working in small groups practicing somersaults on mats during a gymnastics workshop in PE class.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please get into your groups of three to five and practice performing somersaults on the mats.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Exercises briefly, then suddenly leaves the task to go talk to another student in a nearby group) If the teacher wasn't there, we'd just have fun all day.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's get back to your own mat and keep practicing.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Regularly checks the teacher's location in the classroom to be discreet) It's cool; we're winding each other up with my mates, making jokes (laughs).

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Make sure you are taking turns doing the somersaults.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pushes another student during a somersault to make them fall) Yeah, here I'm having a bit of fun with my mate ...(laughs), he's going for a roll and boom ...I push him. He fell over ...We have a laugh together, he did it to me earlier ...We're just having fun ...
